name: vega_1p_sharpa_arm
_note: The torso stays at home. Inverse kinematics moves the right arm, and the policy controls the arm and hand. This variant uses its own base-placement range.

base._note: closer to the support than vega_1p_sharpa's bases (the arm reaches without the torso), and wider

right._ik_joints: the right arm alone; torso, head and left arm hold the home pose (left arm tucked beside the body)

bodex._note: BODex hand asset (grasping.bodex): its base link and joint names are this arm's hand link / joints

right._shoulder: first arm joint's link at home, base frame (z above the base mount): BODex seeds face it

cameras.name: wrist
cameras._source: T-Rex (Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation) collection robot, hardware_code/camera/camera_params.yaml right_wrist: a ZED X One S on the Sharpa / Vega wrist mount, T_ee_cam in R_ee (R_arm_l8 turned 90 deg about z, the frame of this spec's right_hand_C_MC: palm +x, thumb +y), so on the palm side; moved 29.5 mm back along z (the real hand sits that far out from the flange, Sharpa's flange 0.5 mm + wrist 29 mm before right_hand_C_MC; this spec's hand is on the flange). CAD-nominal, cm-level. The renderer's pixels are square: fy renders as fx (vertical field 78 deg against the real 74)

_variant: vega_1p_sharpa_arm with the right wrist camera (apps/episode.py --robot vega_1p_sharpa_arm --robot-spec this)
